destination.name: Nanjing
destination.tagline: A former imperial capital with Ming tombs, a long city wall, lakes and Republic-era sites
destination.description: Nanjing's name means "southern capital", and it served as the capital of several dynasties and, from 1927 to 1949, of the Republic of China. The Hongwu Emperor made it his Ming capital in 1368 and built a city wall that remains the most complete in China. Purple Mountain on the eastern side holds the tombs of Sun Yat-sen, the Hongwu Emperor and Sun Quan, while the Qinhuai River and Xuanwu Lake run through the city and the Yangtze lies to the west. The 1937 Nanjing Massacre is remembered at a large memorial hall in Jianye District.
whyVisit: Visit Ming tombs on Purple Mountain
Stroll lakes and the Qinhuai River

goodToKnow.title: Reserve Purple Mountain entry
goodToKnow.detail: Entry to the Purple Mountain park needs a free reservation, made by WeChat or with your passport at a tourist information centre.

goodToKnow.title: Carry your passport
goodToKnow.detail: You must show your passport to buy a Presidential Palace ticket, and it also works for the free Purple Mountain reservation.

goodToKnow.title: Choose the right station
goodToKnow.detail: Nanjing South handles long-haul high-speed trains. Nanjing (North) station is often easier for Yangzhou, Zhenjiang, Changzhou, Wuxi and Suzhou.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} bring blossom on Purple Mountain and maple colour at Qixia, away from humid summers.
